notes:
{諸|しょ}〜 is a formal prefix meaning 'various' or 'all,' used primarily in written language.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{諸国|しょこく}→諸国：15992_shokoku⟧ (various countries)
- ⟦{諸問題|しょもんだい}→諸問題：24490_shomondai⟧ (various problems)
- ⟦{諸経費|しょけいひ}→諸経費：15155_shokeihi⟧ (miscellaneous expenses)
- ⟦{諸説|しょせつ}→諸説：19128_shosetsu⟧ (various theories)
- ⟦{諸事情|しょじじょう}→諸事情：21955_shojijou⟧ (various circumstances)
- ⟦{諸君|しょくん}→諸君：17136_shokun⟧ (you all; ladies and gentlemen)
- ⟦{諸島|しょとう}→諸島：14343_shotou⟧ (islands; archipelago)

REGISTER:
This prefix has a formal, literary tone. In everyday speech, ⟦{色々|いろいろ}→色々：02352_iroiro⟧な or ⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な are more common for 'various.'

SIMILAR:
- {諸|しょ}〜 (formal; Sino-Japanese)
- ⟦{各|かく}→各〜：00449_kaku⟧〜 (each; every) - focuses on individual items
- ⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な (various) - neutral register
